Regarding Table 5: I recommend reconsidering the presentation of regression results based on a
very small sample (N=39). With such limited observations, the statistical power is questionable and
results may be unstable. As an alternative, you might consider adding an interaction term
between 'crisis parties' and populism to the main analysis, which would allow you to test the
conditional relationship while maintaining adequate sample size. If you retain the separate
analysis, please discuss the limitations explicitly and consider reporting measures of model fit and
diagnostics to assess reliability.

toward the final resubmission.
